en: Based in Freilassing. Has raced BMWs since the 1960s. Back in the DTM with BMW in 2012.
The second HWA AG team, entered as Thomas Sabo/Mercedes-Benz Bank AMG-Mercedes. Gary Paffett won the 2005 title.
Run by HWA AG from Affalterbach. HWA builds and runs the Mercedes DTM cars. One of two HWA teams in 2012.
Keke Rosberg's team from Neustadt an der Weinstraße. First DTM season in 1995 with Opel. Raced Mercedes from 2000 to 2004 and Audi since 2006.
Hans-Jürgen Abt's team from Kempten. Has run Audis in the DTM since 2000. Mattias Ekström won the title with the team in 2004 and 2007.
Founded by Bart Mampaey. Based in Mechelen, Belgium. New to the DTM in 2012.
Founded by Ernst Moser. Based in Meuspath, next to the Nürburgring. Has run Audis in the DTM since 2006.
Stefan Reinhold's team from Andernach. New to the DTM in 2012. Martin Tomczyk won the 2011 title and moves to BMW with the number 1.
The second Abt Sportsline team, also from Kempten. Rahel Frey and the rookie Adrien Tambay drive.
Peter Mücke's team from Berlin. Runs Mercedes cars. Former Formula 1 driver David Coulthard drives for the team.
Persson Motorsport runs two Mercedes cars. Entered as Junge Sterne/TV-Spielfilm AMG-Mercedes.
DTM 2012
Carbon-chassis DTM coupes with about 470 hp and 1,100 kg.

The new 2012 DTM cars (Audi A5, BMW M3, AMG C-Coupe). They corner far faster than Group A saloons but stay well below single-seaters. Same settings as the 2013 cars, which were fitted to the 2013 qualifying times.
